stills.label: proof-play-10m.jpg

puck.evidence: Located at mid-left (x=745, y=715), the near-black disc is roughly 16 pixels wide and highlighted by a faint greenish ground ring.

carrier.evidence: Orange skater #11 stands immediately adjacent to the glowing puck indicator at the center line.

team_colours.evidence: The saturated warm orange and deep cobalt blue jerseys contrast sharply against each other and the white ice.

far_net.evidence: The red goal frame is centered along the far boards (140 pixels wide) and framed by a bright vertical beam.

zone_strips.evidence: The dark red center red line and far blue line cleanly span the full width of the rink across the ice.

stills.first_look: the two large skaters at the center circle
noise: vertical white light shaft ascending from the far net
stepped concentric brightness rings on the ice surface
camera crane and studio lighting equipment behind the far boards

stills.label: proof-play-24m.jpg

puck.evidence: The black disc is reduced to roughly 8 pixels wide near x=1010, y=715, discernible mainly by its surrounding green circle.

carrier.evidence: Orange #11 is next to the puck marker at center ice, but the two massive foreground blue skaters draw attention away.

team_colours.evidence: Deep blue and vivid warm orange remain instantly separable across all visible figures.

far_net.evidence: The red goal frame is centered at the far end, measuring about 110 pixels wide against the illuminated white crease.

zone_strips.evidence: The foreground blue line, dark red center line, and far blue line clearly divide the ice horizontally.

stills.first_look: the large illuminated white spotlight oval in the foreground
noise: massive stepped concentric spotlight rings dominating the ice
bright vertical light column over the far goal
studio equipment and crane fixtures along the upper perimeter

stills.label: proof-play-40m.jpg

puck.evidence: At 40 meters distance the puck is a minute 4-pixel dot at x=1110, y=718, nearly lost despite the faint green indicator ring.

carrier.evidence: Orange figure #11 is next to the puck indicator, but all players are shrunk to tiny silhouettes on the vast ice sheet.

team_colours.evidence: Blue and orange hues remain distinct, though the small figure size reduces rapid peripheral identification.

far_net.evidence: The red frame at the far end is only about 70 pixels wide, visible primarily due to its central placement beneath the vertical beam.

zone_strips.evidence: The three colored transverse lines (near blue, center red, far blue) remain fully legible across the entire rink.

stills.first_look: the bright vertical beam of light above the center of the rink
noise: prominent overhead lighting truss and bright vertical light beam
extensive concentric light banding across the rink surface
studio lights, crane, and track equipment lining the upper and side boundaries

stills.label: play-b-24m.jpg

puck.evidence: The puck is a small 8-pixel dark dot at x=760, y=535, identifiable primarily by the faint green ring on the ice.

carrier.evidence: Orange player #11 is positioned beside the puck halo, but the two large foreground blue figures dominate visual weight.

team_colours.evidence: Warm orange and deep royal blue figures provide immediate, high-contrast team differentiation.

far_net.evidence: The red goal frame is clearly visible at center top (roughly 85 pixels wide) directly over the illuminated white crease.

zone_strips.evidence: The bold blue foreground line, red center line, and upper blue line cleanly demarcate rink zones edge to edge.

stills.first_look: the bright white foreground ice patch framing the two blue skaters
noise: concentric banded spotlight circles on the ice
bright vertical light pillar rising from behind the far goal
camera crane, floodlights, and set dressing beyond the dasher boards
